definitions.TP: Ground-truth ambiguous phrase detected by Qwen (no similarity threshold).
definitions.FN: Ground-truth ambiguous phrase missed by Qwen.
definitions.FP: Phrase flagged by Qwen that is not a ground-truth ambiguity.
definitions.FPR_turn_level: Turns with no ground-truth ambiguity are negatives. FPR = negative turns where Qwen predicted >=1 ambiguity / all negative turns.
definitions.semantic_similarity: Cosine similarity of Sentence-BERT embeddings (predicted_resolution vs ground_truth_resolution), detected phrases only.
definitions.sentence_similarity_rougeL_f1: ROUGE-L F1 (lexical overlap), detected phrases only.
